purpose: Finite exploratory comparison of targets, ranking loss and intraday information
architecture: Identical 13-feature THINK+mixer, width 16, historical train-only graph; no architecture search
residual_target: Five-session stock economic return minus signal-close lagged beta times the identical entry/exit QQQ return
ranking_loss: Residual MSE in percentage-point squared units plus 1.0 times mean pairwise logistic loss; predicted pair difference divided by fixed 1 percentage point; unequal labeled pairs only; equal date weights
checkpoint_criterion: Highest mean validation QQQ-beta-residual RankIC for ALL three objectives; earliest tie within 1e-7; constant-score/label origins score zero
splits: Same prior-year validation, purged annual folds and training-only normalization as the completed Alpaca study
data: Reuse immutable reviewed 2018-2025 economic daily panel and date-bounded Alpaca session features; no universe or coverage changes
portfolio: Fixed equal top 10, five-seed eligible-rank ensemble; next-close fills, continuous $1m accounts; same 1% ADV caps and modeled costs
controls: Prior completed MSE-stopped THINK+mixer paths, shared ridge residual model with fixed lambda 10 for both views, monthly basket, SPY and QQQ
rank_inference: 10000 joint circular-block samples of 200 complete forecast origins; blocks 1/4/12 origins; primary 4 (~20 sessions). Seven contrasts: three intraday-minus-daily, residual-MSE-minus-raw and residual-rank-minus-residual-MSE in each view. Simultaneous max-statistic diagnostic within this seven-contrast family.
financial_inference: 10000 joint circular-block samples of paired daily returns; blocks 5/20/60 sessions; primary 20. Nineteen contrasts: twelve model-minus-ETF, three intraday-minus-daily, two residual-MSE-minus-raw and two rank-minus-residual-MSE. Separate family from RankIC; no joint confirmation claim.
stop_rule: No financial or test ranking metrics before all 120 fits and sources are locked. Disclose every cell/seed/cost. No target, beta, rank-weight, K or epoch-rule retuning from test outcomes.
history_status: 2022-2025 already inspected across prior experiments; all new historical results are exploratory development, never untouched confirmation

future_confirmation.selection_rule: After updated point-in-time data review, choose one of the six cells using only the median across five seeds of prior-year validation residual RankIC; ties within 1e-7 follow the declared views/objectives order. Lock choice, refit schedule, data, issuer support and account implementation before first future signal.
future_confirmation.data_gate: Extend and independently review historical membership, issuer identities, corporate actions and both input views through first signal. Existing 156-node mixer cannot silently drop newly admitted securities: complete schema and train-support review required before launch.
future_confirmation.inference_gate: No repeated interim promotion; first fixed 252-session report is preliminary and may be underpowered. Any claim requires positive simultaneous net active-mean lower bounds versus both SPY and QQQ, full research/training uncertainty disclosure and further confirmation.
future_confirmation.execution: No trading orders, scheduled jobs or automatic future evaluation are authorized by this protocol alone. User can request a later forward run.
